verification.heading: People the public website cannot identify
verification.intro: The public site checks a national ID against a date of birth, and accepts a phone number instead only when no date of birth is on file. Anyone with neither cannot apply, cannot check an application and cannot ask to be connected to a buyer — until a member of staff records one of the two.
verification.none: Nobody is in this state. Every person on file has a date of birth, so anyone can look themselves up. This list is checked against the record, not assumed — an empty list means it was checked and found nothing.
verification.loadFailed: The list could not be loaded.
verification.cannotHeading: {count, plural, one {# person cannot use the site at all} other {# people cannot use the site at all}}
verification.cannotBody: No date of birth and no phone number. Ask for either one and add it through the record they appear in — a training completion, an office visit or a guidance record.
verification.phoneOnlyHeading: {count, plural, one {# person is verified by phone only} other {# people are verified by phone only}}
verification.phoneOnlyBody: No date of birth, but a phone number is on file, so the site can still find them. Adding a date of birth is better: a phone number changes.

municipalityGate.title: Choose a municipality
municipalityGate.body: You are signed in as a super admin and are not working in either municipality yet. Choose one to see its dashboard and enter its records; the switcher in the header changes it later. Accounts and settings need no municipality: they are in the account menu, under your name.

evidence.title: Evidence files
evidence.rule: Files are compressed on this device before upload: a photograph to 1600 px JPEG, a scanned document to a grey 150 DPI PDF. Anything still over 1 MB after that is refused.
evidence.objectKept: The file's record was removed, but the file itself is still in the evidence store. Tell the platform administrator (super admin) so it can be cleared.

refusal.too_large: {name} is still {compressed} after compression (it was {original}), and the limit is {limit} per file. Take the photograph at a lower resolution, or split a long document into parts.
refusal.unsupported_type: A file of this type ({type}) cannot be treated as that kind. Choose Photograph for an image, Scanned document for an image or PDF, or Other file.
refusal.unreadable: {name} could not be read as an image or PDF on this device.
refusal.r2_not_configured: Evidence storage is not configured yet. The platform administrator has to set these Edge Function secrets: {missing}.
refusal.not_signed_in: Your session ended. Sign in again and try once more.
refusal.not_permitted: Your role does not allow this. Ask the Coordinator.
refusal.coordinator_only: Only a coordinator may remove evidence.
refusal.not_found: That record is not visible to your role, or no longer exists.
refusal.record_deleted: This record is deleted, so no evidence can be added to it. Restore it first.
refusal.file_too_large: This file is over the {limit} per-file limit.
refusal.quota_exceeded: Evidence storage has reached its limit: {used} used of the {quota} stop. This file was not added. Tell the platform administrator (super admin) before adding more evidence.
refusal.object_missing: The upload did not arrive at the store. Try again.
refusal.size_mismatch: The store received a different size from the one uploaded, so the file was discarded. Try again.
refusal.store_unreachable: The evidence store did not answer. Try again in a moment.
refusal.upload_failed: The upload to the evidence store failed ({code}). If this keeps happening, the store's CORS rule may not allow this site.
refusal.bucket_mismatch: This file is in a different store from the one configured. Tell the platform administrator.
refusal.bad_request: The request was not understood. This is a defect in the screen.
refusal.unknown: The file could not be added.

storage.stop: The platform stops adding files at {stop}, before the included storage is exceeded and billed. Each file is at most {perFile} after compression.
